title: Verghese Kurien  I Too Had a Dream
subject: English
summary: “Verghese Kurien – I Too Had a Dream” is an inspiring chapter about Dr. Verghese Kurien, who is known as the Father of the White Revolution in India. He played an important role in making India one of the largest milk-producing countries in the world. He started the Amul cooperative movement in Gujarat to help poor farmers and milk producers earn a better income. Through his hard work, dedication and leadership, he improved the lives of millions of farmers. His efforts also made India self-reliant in milk production. The chapter teaches us that with hard work, determination and a strong vision, we can bring positive changes to society and achieve our dreams.
